response.description:
To meet growing demand for GPU-powered workloads, Azure
Container Apps serverless GPUs are
now generally available in additional regions. This expansion enables
developers to run AI inference, model training, and GPU-accelerated workloads
with the simplicity of a serverless experience.   Newly Available Regions:   Americas: East US, West US
2, South Central US, North Central US, Brazil South   Asia: Japan East, Southeast
Asia, Central India, South India   Europe: France Central,
Italy North   Benefits of serverless GPUs:   Scale-to zero GPUs: Support
for automatic serverless scaling of NVIDIA A100 and NVIDIA T4 GPUs.   Per-second billing: Pay
only for the GPU compute you use.   Built-in data governance:
Your data never leaves the container boundary.   Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Container Apps serverless GPUs in additional regions
